description.content: Get information about a specific package in Nixpkgs, including a list of releases, platforms, and outputs. Use this endpoint when you know the package name. To search for packages use /search; for only the latest matching version use /resolve.

query.description: (Required) The name of the package you want to look up. Must be a valid Nixpkgs package name.

response.name: Ok
Bad Request: empty package name (set a ?name=<pkg> query parameter)

description.content:
The Nixhub API lets you search over 1 million package versions for over 100,000 Nix packages. Search for packages, look up version history, and resolve a package name + version to a nixpkgs commit and flake installable for use with Devbox or Nix. Free for personal use, subject to IP-based rate limiting. Built and operated by Jetify.
